text:
Maria Chen: Heads up: we see a sudden drop in prefix cache hit rate across us-west clusters, backend QPS for model-proxy spiked x5 and latency jumped. Triage in thread?

Ajay Patel: On it. metrics?

Maria Chen: tail of metrics: prefix_hit_rate for model-a: 91% -> 22% in 3m. cache-service 503s. sample log:
```
{"ts":1950001234,"svc":"cache","err":"OOM alloc failed"}
```

Leo Summers: Seeing thundering-miss pattern, many cold prefixes after recent rollout of tokenizer normalization change? @Ajay any related deploys?

Ajay Patel: Rolled tokenizer-normalization v2 at 1950001000. Rollback started. I'm going to toggle cache warmup job off and reduce prefetch concurrency.

SRE Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Incident created: IN-1950. Pager oncall notified.

Maria Chen: We did an emergency flip of prefix cache to 'bypass' for affected models to stop backend overload. Command used:
`/run infra toggle-feature prefix_cache --model=model-a --state=off`

CacheBot: prefix_cache bypass enabled for model-a on us-west-2 (propagated in 28s).

Leo Summers: After bypass, backend QPS back to normal, but CPU cost increased on runtime due to more kernel fallbacks. Profiling shows increase in small-kernel invocations. We should avoid long-term bypass.

Ajay Patel: Plan: 1) revert tokenizer-normalization v2 (complete) 2) reintroduce cache with stricter keying (strip session id) 3) add miss dedupe 4) lower prefetch concurrency to 2 5) enable soft-warmup (gradual) — rolling patch ETA 30m.

Maria Chen: Can we also add token-length bucketed kernel selection to prevent tiny-kernel thrash? batching heuristics to prefer larger batches when cache misses spike.

Leo Summers: Agree. I'll open a quick PR to: - add miss_dedupe TTL 5s - metric for dedupe hits - buffer prefetch queue when miss rate >30%

Ajay Patel: Also tagging: if cache-service latency >200ms, route to fallback-model-quantized to reduce kernel pressure.

SRE Oncall Bot: Postmortem flag set. Assigning to Ajay + Leo + Maria.

Maria Chen: :thumbsup: monitoring dashboards updated. Will follow up with perf numbers in #eng-runtime tomorrow.
